title: 4 Signs Your Words Don’t Match Your Faith
paragraphs: 4 Signs Your Words Don’t Match Your Faith

They said “I’m a Christian.”
But their words… cut deeper than unbelief.
Pause.
Because this isn’t about them.
It might be about you.

1. You praise God on Sunday… but poison people on Monday.
Worship songs still echo in your chest—
yet gossip drips from your lips.

James didn’t stutter: “Out of the same mouth come praise and cursing.”
My brother. My sister.
This should not be.

2. You quote Scripture… but use it to wound, not heal.
You know the verses.
You drop them like stones.

But Ephesians says speak what builds up—
not what breaks down.

Truth without love
is just noise with a Bible verse attached.

3. You say “God is in control”… but your mouth is full of fear.
Anxiety speaks louder than your theology.

Every sentence sounds like defeat.
Every word rehearses worst-case endings.

But Proverbs declares:
“Life and death are in the power of the tongue.”

What are you releasing?
Faith… or fear?

4. You confess Jesus… but deny Him with your tone.
Not just what you say—
but how you say it.
Sarcasm. Pride. Harshness.

Jesus Christ said,
“Out of the overflow of the heart, the mouth speaks.”

So if your words are toxic—
it’s not a mouth problem.
It’s a heart issue.
But here’s what we miss…

God isn’t just listening to your words.
He’s after your heart.
And that’s where grace walks in.

Because the same mouth that failed—
can be redeemed.

The same tongue that cursed—
can now carry life.

Through the cross,
Jesus Christ didn’t just forgive your sins—
He transforms your speech, your spirit, your story.
So today…

Don’t just fix your vocabulary.
Surrender your heart.

Let Him clean the source—
and your words will follow.
